leadText:
A Lady (Japanese: おじょうさま High-class Girl) is a type of Pokémon Trainer that first debuted in the Generation III games. They are depicted as girls dressed in elaborate and fancy clothing. In , , Caitlin is referred to as a Lady. In , a notable Lady is Selphy. Their male counterparts are s.

They generally use weak but pay out a large amount of money as a reward; the largest recorded prize money after a Trainer battle was 10,240, which can be multiplied to 20,480 with an Amulet Coin or Luck Incense. Many of their Pokémon also carry Nuggets or Stardust in the Generation III main series games. They use Full Restores to heal their own Pokémon in battle.

In , they appear in the Battle Chateau, where they appear as a , , , or . They also appear in the Battle Maison, meaning there are no Ladies that can be battled outside of the Battle Maison.

==In animation==
 
===Pokémon the Series===
==== ====
In The Ribbon Cup Caper, Brodie disguised himself as a woman that resembled the depiction of this Trainer class.

====Pokémon movies====
A Lady appeared at the beginning of Jirachi: Wish Maker, having a with . The same Lady made a cameo in Giratina and the Sky Warrior with and seven of its Evolutions. She is based on the Lady from Pokémon Ruby, Sapphire, and Emerald.

A Lady appeared with her in Destiny Deoxys.

==== ====
In A Full Course Tag Battle!, Kylie is based on the sprite for a Lady, just as Roman is based on the Trainer class.

==== ====
In Crowning the Chow Crusher!, a Lady was among the contestants that entered the Pokémon Grand Eating Contest. Though she managed to get past the first round, her was unable to continue due to feeding it tampered cookies that filled up its stomach.

====History====
===== =====
 
Selphy made a brief cameo with her butler, Sebastian in Put Your Beast Foot Forward.

===== =====
A Lady was one of the people swarming the Mossdeep Space Center in Diancie Shines.

===== =====
In Perturbed by Pachirisu, a Lady appeared as one of the participants of a that also participated in. Despite the Lady's messing up the contents of Platinum's Fashion Case, Platinum got first place in the Super Contest.

In Bombastic Bibarel & Heroic Hippopotas, a Lady appeared in the Seven Stars Restaurant with a Rich Boy. Another Lady and her , who are not very attached to each other, appeared as an example of Dr. Footstep's explanation that footprints can be used to discern how a Pokémon is attached to its Trainer.

===== =====
In Deprogramming Porygon-Z, a Lady challenging the Battle Castle was shown with her .

===== =====
In An Odd Speech, a Lady was seen listening to Ghetsis's speech.

===== =====
In Kangaskhan...Kangascan't, a Lady and her appeared at Santalune City.

A Lady was seen in 's flashback in Pinsir Glares.
